reconstruction.DDB.3: Whole stock invariant is available plus active quantities equals capacity. Atomic conditional decrement + reservation + operation payload/result; identity scoped by principal, reject differing payload; all-transaction bounded retry or refusal; unknown external effect reconciled before retry.
reconstruction.DDB.4: Freeze answer/order/workload, compare correct baseline with target index, equal answers and write/storage costs. SCAN->SEARCH does not establish milliseconds or service SLO.
reconstruction.DDB.5: Time questions determine snapshot/version/events; authoritative data plus derivation determine projection. Creation/cancellation once, duplicate/order/freshness handling and rebuild; accepted qty cannot reconstruct never-saved requested qty.
reconstruction.DDB.6: Map old/new/mixed readers/writers, choose stop or expand/contract, coordinate live backfill writes, cents->thousandths times10; 1995 not expressible by old cents field. Snapshot after A requires reliable ordered replay delta B to restore all acknowledged changes.
